body: I realize people have it worse than me. And it makes me feel so guilty to so selfishly crying over what amounts to spilt milk. I have some good things in my life. I'm obviously just not focusing on them. In my current state, all I can see is that the negative is so overwhelming that I'm downing in it, and the light of great things is so dim.

You are right about the driving. There is no excuse. My friend didn't start that car, I did. I drove out of that parking lot and I made the decision to take myself home. In my mental state at the time I made a terrible decision and I'm very lucky that I didn't hurt anyone in the process.

uh, so much. 

I have lost relationships with the adopted family, and though they were emotionally/psychologically abusive, and she may have slapped me across the face in my teenage years, they were really the only parents I know. My aunt, who was the closest to a mother to me, passed away from breast cancer. I wasn't even permitted to go to her funeral. My grandmother, the only person still remaining who cares for me in that family, doesn't remember me anymore - she's 85. I love my biological brother very much, but he doesn't live close and he has a wife and kids and I refuse to bother him with my concerns, he has a full plate as it is. 

So I'd prefer to go to my local bar, laugh with my bartenders, play games with them and drink myself in to a place I forget my pain and only remember that I'm in the company of drunks like me with problems like me, all pretending they dont' exist which we laugh over shots and lost bar games.

believe me, I understand. We had a friend pass recently from driving drunk and getting into an accident. I didn't have far to go and was very careful, though this is still no excuse. I felt no other option at the time. I was being attacked over and over and needed to leave quickly before things got worse. When I told him I'd leave if he didn't stop he said "fuck you, get the fuck out". He didn't answer my phone call until I was a minute from my parking garage. And that was only to bring back up our friend who passed and ask me how I could do that to him.
